The main takeaway from our work is that

the side-chain lengths in these two perfluorosulonic acid polymers are not a major determinant of the macroscopic proton transport properties, but rather, the local structure and composition of the water channels are more important.

, while the local structure of the polymer side chains and water channels in Nafion and in Hyflon are very similar, the differences in the side chain lengths have a profound effect on the macroscopic transport properties.
